styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: Live preview of the design tokens and formats. Changes are saved to your preferences.

gallery.sampleSummary: Sample data: daily reach of three accounts over 30 days.
gallery.deleteBody: This removes its stored insights. This cannot be undone.
gallery.noAccountsHint: Connect an Instagram account to start collecting insights.
gallery.creator: Creator
gallery.dialogBody: Log in to Instagram to connect it.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Your Instagram insights, in one place.

errors.not_owner: This account is not allowed to use in2sight.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Check your device's clock and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.secret: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.disableBody: Your account will only be protected by your password.
twoFactor.recovery: Lost your device? Remove the factor in the Supabase dashboard (Authentication → Users). See docs/RUNBOOK_AUTH.md (Recovery section).
twoFactor.errorNeedsAal2: Sign in again with your authenticator code to change two-factor settings.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Connect, group and monitor your Instagram accounts
accounts.emptyHint: Connect an Instagram account to start collecting insights.

connect.title: Add an Instagram account
connect.groupHint: Leave empty to keep the account isolated.
connect.notes: Creator or Business accounts only. You'll log in on Instagram's own page and approve read-only access.

archive.title: Archive @{username}?
archive.body: Syncing stops and the account is hidden. Its history is kept, and reconnecting restores it.

delete.title: Delete @{username} permanently?
delete.body: All collected history for this account will be erased. This cannot be undone. Type the username to confirm.

errors.state_mismatch: The sign-in session expired. Please try again.
errors.missing_code: Instagram did not return a login code. Try again.
errors.exchange_failed: Instagram rejected the login. Try again.
errors.profile_failed: Couldn't read the account profile. Try again.
errors.not_professional: That account is not a Creator or Business account. Switch it in Instagram first.
errors.save_failed: Couldn't save the account. Try again.
errors.not_configured: Instagram isn't configured yet. See docs/META_SETUP.md.
errors.unauthorized: You are not allowed to do that.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_group: That group name is not valid (max 40 characters).
errors.not_archived: Only archived accounts can do that.
errors.token_invalid: Instagram rejected the access token. Reconnect the account.
errors.rate_limited: Instagram is limiting requests. Sync retries automatically.
errors.instagram_unavailable: Instagram is temporarily unavailable. Sync retries automatically.
errors.instagram_error: Instagram returned an error. Sync retries automatically.
errors.busy: A sync is already running for this account.
errors.not_active: Only active accounts can be synced.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.hint: This page could not be loaded. Try again, or go to your accounts.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyHint: Connect an Instagram account to start collecting insights.
overview.subtitle: Your accounts at a glance
overview.compareHint: Scoped to a group by default — widen to compare everything
overview.chartSummary: Daily reach of {count} accounts over the last {days} days. The table below lists the same accounts.

stories.empty: No Stories captured in the last 14 days
stories.emptyHint: Stories are captured every 30 minutes while they are live. Stories from before the account was connected can't be retrieved.
stories.liveHint: {count, plural, one {# snapshot so far} other {# snapshots so far}}
stories.finalHint: Final numbers · {count, plural, one {# snapshot} other {# snapshots}}
stories.open: Open the Story from {time} on Instagram

audience.emptyHint: Audience data appears once the account has 100+ followers and the daily sync has run.

account.trendSummary: Daily reach and views over the last {days} days.
account.followersSummary: Daily follower count over the last {days} days.
account.formatsHint: Average reach and engagement per format, from each post's latest metrics
account.pooled: {count, plural, one {# account pooled} other {# accounts pooled}}

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.dayLabel: {date}: {posts, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, {stories, plural, one {# story} other {# stories}}
calendar.truncated: This month has more items than can be shown. Pick one account to see the rest.

tags.title: Tags
tags.subtitle: Content pillars across all accounts, from each post's latest metrics
tags.emptyHint: Create a tag above, then label posts from an account's Posts tab.
tags.name: Name
tags.caption: Tag performance
tags.deleteBody: It is removed from every post. The posts and their numbers stay.

errors.duplicate: A tag with this name already exists.
errors.not_found: That tag or post no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.too_many: Too many tags: a post can have at most 10, and there can be 500 tags in total.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

reasons.not_enough_history: Not enough history to compare yet
reasons.not_enough_posts: Needs ~30+ posts for a reliable pattern
reasons.needs_5_viewers: Instagram shares Story insights from 5 viewers
